Derived from every `process.env` read in `src/` and from `SETTINGS_SCHEMA` in [settings.js](src/routes/settings.js). **504 keys** across **22 groups**. Descriptions come from the Settings UI, defaults from the code, so neither can drift from what actually runs.

## ⚠️ Conflicting engine defaults

These keys are given **different fallbacks at different engine call sites**. With the key unset, behaviour depends on which module evaluated first — usually a bug.

| Key | Defaults seen | Files |
|---|---|---|
| `BACKTEST_THETA_DAY` | `8`×10, `10`×4 | `src/routes/bbRsiBacktest.js`, `src/routes/haScalpBacktest.js`, `src/routes/orbBacktest.js`, `src/routes/paBacktest.js`, `src/routes/rsiPivotStBacktest.js`, `src/routes/trendDayScalpBacktest.js`, `src/routes/trendPbBacktest.js`, `src/services/backtestEngine.js`, `src/services/ema9vwapBacktestEngine.js` |
| `BB_RSI_ENABLED` | `(any but true)`×2, `false`×1 | `src/app.js`, `src/routes/bbRsiLive.js` |
| `EMA_RSI_ST_LIVE_ENABLED` | `false`×5, `(any but true)`×1 | `src/app.js`, `src/routes/auth.js`, `src/routes/emaRsiStLive.js`, `src/routes/emaRsiStLiveHarness.js` |
| `INSTRUMENT` | `(not NIFTY_FUTURES)`×7, `NIFTY_OPTIONS`×1 | `src/config/instrument.js`, `src/routes/bbRsiLiveHarness.js`, `src/routes/ema9vwapLiveHarness.js`, `src/routes/emaRsiStLiveHarness.js`, `src/routes/orbLiveHarness.js`, `src/routes/paLiveHarness.js`, `src/routes/trendDayScalpLiveHarness.js`, `src/routes/trendPbLiveHarness.js` |
| `PA_ENABLED` | `(any but true)`×2, `true`×1 | `src/app.js`, `src/routes/paLive.js` |

## EARLYBIRD STRATEGY (first 15-min breakout, CASH EQUITY) — Fyers

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `EARLYBIRD_BROKERAGE_PER_ORDER` | number | — | Per-leg brokerage cap used when costing a paper trade. The discount-broker standard is ₹20 or 0.03%, whichever is lower. |
| `EARLYBIRD_BT_CACHE_DAYS` | number | — | How long a cached history file survives before it is re-fetched. |
| `EARLYBIRD_BT_CONCURRENCY` | number | — | How many symbols' history are fetched in parallel during a backtest. Higher is faster but risks Fyers rate limits. |
| `EARLYBIRD_BT_DAILY_LOOKBACK_DAYS` | number | — | How far back the daily series is pulled so every simulated day has a previous close for the gap rule, even after a long holiday. |
| `EARLYBIRD_BT_RPM` | number | `180` | The second Fyers history window. Both this and the per-second cap are honoured. |
| `EARLYBIRD_BT_RPS` | number | `8` | Fyers meters history requests per second. Lower this if a wide-range run starts failing. |
| `EARLYBIRD_BT_SLIPPAGE_PTS` | number | — | Backtest cost per side, in rupees of stock price. Applied to both entry and exit. Without it a breakout backtest always flatters. |
| `EARLYBIRD_CHG_BROKERAGE_CAP` | number | `20` | Maximum brokerage per leg. The discount-broker standard is ₹20. |
| `EARLYBIRD_CHG_BROKERAGE_PCT` | number | `0.03` | Percentage brokerage per leg, before the cap below. |
| `EARLYBIRD_CHG_EXCHANGE_PCT` | number | `0.00297` | NSE equity transaction charge on total turnover. Much smaller than the options rate — this is why option charges cannot be reused here. |
| `EARLYBIRD_CHG_GST_PCT` | number | `18` | GST charged on brokerage + exchange + SEBI fees. |
| `EARLYBIRD_CHG_SEBI_PER_CRORE` | number | `10` | SEBI turnover fee, in rupees per crore of turnover. |
| `EARLYBIRD_CHG_STAMP_PCT` | number | `0.003` | Stamp duty on the BUY leg of an equity-intraday trade. |
| `EARLYBIRD_CHG_STT_PCT` | number | `0.025` | Securities Transaction Tax on the SELL leg of an equity-intraday trade. NSE rate is 0.025%. |
| `EARLYBIRD_DAILY_PROFIT_LOCK` | number | — | Stop for the day once this much is banked (0 = off, the default). |
| `EARLYBIRD_ENTRY_BUFFER_PTS` | number | — | How far past the signal candle the pending order and the stop sit — "a little above the breakout candle". Applied to BOTH ends: entry beyond the extreme, stop beyond the other extreme. |
| `EARLYBIRD_ENTRY_END` | time | — | No new entries after this time (IST). The rule is 10:45; a pending order not triggered by then is cancelled. |
| `EARLYBIRD_ENTRY_START` | time | — | No entries before this (IST) — the signal candle has just closed. |
| `EARLYBIRD_FORCED_EXIT` | time | — | Hard square-off (IST). The rule is "exit at 1 pm" — anything still open closes at market here. |
| `EARLYBIRD_HISTORY_LAG_MS` | number | — | How long after 09:30 before the history endpoint is asked for the opening candle. Too short and the bar is not published yet, which would lose the whole day. |
| `EARLYBIRD_LIVE_DRY_RUN` | toggle | `false` | Keep it simulated even when live is on. |
| `EARLYBIRD_LIVE_ENABLED` | toggle | `false` | Enable live CASH EQUITY orders via Fyers. NEVER traded — paper-validate first, then diff a recorded session in /replay. |
| `EARLYBIRD_MAX_CONCURRENT` | number | — | How many stocks may be held simultaneously. When more confirm than this, the tightest-stop names are taken first. |
| `EARLYBIRD_MAX_DAILY_LOSS` | number | — | Stop trading after this much loss (0 = off). Note 100 shares of a ₹3,000 stock is a ₹300,000 position — size this deliberately. |
| `EARLYBIRD_MAX_DAILY_LOSSES` | number | — | Day ends after this many stop-outs (0 = off). |
| `EARLYBIRD_MAX_DAILY_TRADES` | number | — | Max entries per day across all stocks. |
| `EARLYBIRD_MAX_GAP_PCT` | number | — | Skip a stock that opened more than this far from the previous day's close, in either direction. This is the "don't trade a stock which opened about 2% than the previous day" rule. |
| `EARLYBIRD_MAX_OPPOSING_WICK_PCT` | number | — | The wick that argues AGAINST the move — the upper wick on a green candle, the lower wick on a red one. This one number covers all three drawings: a full-body candle, a long favourable wick, and a small opposing wick. Lower = stricter. |
| `EARLYBIRD_MAX_SL_PTS` | number | — | When the wick-to-wick risk is wider than this, the stop moves off the wick and onto the candle's BODY edge (open/close) instead — the "if the breakout candle is too big, ignore the wick" rule. It can only ever tighten the stop. |
| `EARLYBIRD_MAX_WEEKLY_LOSS` | number | — | Stop for the week after this much loss (0 = off). |
| `EARLYBIRD_MIN_BODY_PCT` | number | — | The body must be a real body, as a share of the candle's own range. Stops a tiny-bodied candle with two long wicks counting as a strength candle. |
| `EARLYBIRD_MIN_CONFIRMING_STOCKS` | number | — | How many stocks must print the same-direction opening candle as NIFTY before the day is tradeable. 1 = the rule as specified. Raising it turns this into a market-breadth gate. |
| `EARLYBIRD_MIN_RANGE_PTS` | number | — | Ignore an opening candle whose whole range is smaller than this. OFF by default — the rules do not ask for it. |
| `EARLYBIRD_PAPER_ENABLED` | toggle | `true` | Allow new EarlyBird paper sessions. |
| `EARLYBIRD_POLL_MS` | number | — | How often the shortlisted stocks' prices are refreshed while setups are pending or positions are open. |
| `EARLYBIRD_QTY` | number | — | Shares per position. This is CASH EQUITY, not options — there are no lots. |
| `EARLYBIRD_QUOTE_CHUNK` | number | — | How many shortlisted symbols are requested per quote call. EarlyBird polls REST quotes for its shortlist rather than pushing equity symbols through the shared NIFTY socket. |
| `EARLYBIRD_QUOTE_STALE_SEC` | number | — | A price older than this stops being used for exit decisions, and the failure is surfaced on the status page. Stops a position being managed off a frozen quote. |
| `EARLYBIRD_RESOLUTION` | select | — | The chart the rules were read off. 15 minutes is the strategy as specified — the day's FIRST candle is the signal candle. |
| `EARLYBIRD_SCAN_CONCURRENCY` | number | — | How many symbols are fetched in parallel during the 09:30 scan. Each one issues two calls (intraday + daily), so the real number in flight is double this. |
| `EARLYBIRD_SCAN_RPM` | number | `180` | The second Fyers history window. Both this and the per-second cap are honoured. |
| `EARLYBIRD_SCAN_RPS` | number | `8` | Fyers meters history calls per second. Exceeding it makes Fyers answer 'no data' — indistinguishable from a delisted stock — so an over-fast scan silently reports most of the universe as having no candle. A full ~220-name scan takes about 2 minutes at this rate, well inside the entry window. |
| `EARLYBIRD_SEBI_PCT` | number | — | SEBI fee as a percentage of turnover (₹10 per crore). |
| `EARLYBIRD_SESSION_START` | time | — | Where the day's first candle begins (IST). This is the signal candle. |
| `EARLYBIRD_STAMP_PCT` | number | — | Stamp duty on the BUY leg only. |
| `EARLYBIRD_STT_PCT` | number | — | Securities Transaction Tax on the SELL leg. Equity intraday is 0.025%, far below the options rate. |
| `EARLYBIRD_TARGET_RR` | number | — | Book profit at this multiple of the actual risk. 2 = the 1:2 in the rules; set 1 for the 1:1 the rules also allow. |
| `EARLYBIRD_TXN_PCT` | number | — | NSE equity transaction charge on total turnover. |
| `EARLYBIRD_UNIVERSE` | select | `FNO` | Which list of stocks is scanned at 09:30. FNO (~220 names) is the list from the strategy's own stock-selection slides. |
| `EARLYBIRD_WARMUP_DAYS` | number | — | How far back to fetch. Only the previous daily close is strictly needed (for the gap rule), so this is small by design. |

## EMA_RSI_ST STRATEGY (EMA 20/50 + RSI + SuperTrend) — Zerodha

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `EMA_RSI_ST_CANDLE_TRAIL_BARS` | number | `3` | Candles looked back for the trailing stop. |
| `EMA_RSI_ST_CANDLE_TRAIL_ENABLED` | toggle | `false` | Add a candle-based trailing stop. |
| `EMA_RSI_ST_CLOSE_BEYOND_EMA_ENABLED` | toggle | `true` | Candle must close on the trade side of the EMA. |
| `EMA_RSI_ST_CONFIRM_CANDLE_ENABLED` | toggle | `true` | Wait for a second candle to confirm entry. |
| `EMA_RSI_ST_EMA_EXIT_MODE` | select | `touch` | How the EMA21 line ends a trade. Touch = today's rule: the candle only has to REACH EMA21, and EMA21 is also the tick-by-tick stop, so a single wick closes the trade. Cross &amp; close = wicks through the line are held and the trade exits only when a candle CLOSES beyond EMA21 (CE on a close below it, PE on a close above). In cross &amp; close mode EMA21 stops being the tick stop — otherwise the first wick would stop you out anyway — so keep the Candle Trail on (or a points Stop Loss) to hold the hard stop. |
| `EMA_RSI_ST_EMA_FAST` | number | `20` | Fast EMA period. |
| `EMA_RSI_ST_EMA_FASTEST` | number | `9` | Fastest EMA period (triple-stack only). |
| `EMA_RSI_ST_EMA_SLOW` | number | `50` | Slow EMA period. |
| `EMA_RSI_ST_EMA_TRIPLE_STACK_ENABLED` | toggle | `false` | Require a 9>20>50 EMA stack (stricter). |
| `EMA_RSI_ST_EOD_EXIT_TIME` | time | `15:15` | Close any open position at this time (IST). |
| `EMA_RSI_ST_INITIAL_SL_MODE` | select | `prev_candle` | Where the stop sits the moment you enter. Previous candle = today's rule: the stop is the last completed candle's low (CE) / high (PE) — structural, but often only a few points from the fill, so ordinary noise stops the trade out within seconds. EMA21 = seed the stop on the SAME EMA21 line the trail already rides, so entry protection and trail protection are one line. EMA21 usually sits further from price, which means fewer instant stop-outs but a bigger loss when it is hit. Applied only when EMA21 is on the protective side of the fill (below entry for CE, above for PE); otherwise the previous-candle stop is kept. |
| `EMA_RSI_ST_LIVE_ENABLED` | toggle | `false` ⚠️ also `(any but true)`×1 | Enable live orders via Zerodha. |
| `EMA_RSI_ST_MAX_CONSEC_LOSSES` | number | `0` | Stop for the day after this many losses in a row (0 = off). |
| `EMA_RSI_ST_NEG_CANDLE_LIMIT` | number | `2` | Exit if still losing after this many candles (0 = off). |
| `EMA_RSI_ST_OPPOSITE_SIDE_COOLDOWN_CANDLES` | number | `3` | Opposite-side cooldown length in candles. |
| `EMA_RSI_ST_OPPOSITE_SIDE_COOLDOWN_ENABLED` | toggle | `true` | Pause the opposite side briefly after an exit. |
| `EMA_RSI_ST_SL_PAUSE_CANDLES` | number | `3` | Pause the same side this many candles after a stop (0 = off). |
| `EMA_RSI_ST_STOP_LOSS_PTS` | number | `0` | Max loss per trade in points (0 = off). |
| `EMA_RSI_ST_SUPERTREND_MULT` | number | `3` | SuperTrend band width multiplier. |
| `EMA_RSI_ST_SUPERTREND_PERIOD` | number | `10` | SuperTrend ATR period. |
| `MAX_DAILY_LOSS` | number | `5000` | Stop trading after this much loss. |
| `MAX_DAILY_TRADES` | number | `20` | Max entries per day. |
| `OPT_STOP_PCT` | number | `0.15` | Exit if option premium drops this fraction. |
| `RSI_CE_MAX` | number | `80` | Block CE when RSI is this high (overbought). |
| `RSI_CE_MIN` | number | `52` | CE needs RSI above this. |
| `RSI_PE_MAX` | number | `48` | PE needs RSI below this. |
| `RSI_PE_MIN` | number | `20` | Block PE when RSI is this low (oversold). |
| `TRADE_EXPIRY_DAY_ONLY` | toggle | `false` | Only trade on weekly expiry day. |
| `VIX_FILTER_ENABLED` | toggle | `true` | Block entries when VIX is high. |
| `VIX_MAX_ENTRY` | number | `20` ⚠️ also `22`×2 | Block entries above this VIX. |

## HA SCALP STRATEGY (Heikin Ashi 15m) — Zerodha

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `HA_SCALP_BT_SEED_PREMIUM` | number | `240` | Assumed entry premium for the backtest (₹). |
| `HA_SCALP_BT_SLIPPAGE_PTS` | number | `1.5` | Backtest cost per side, in points. Without this, option-buying backtests always flatter. |
| `HA_SCALP_DAILY_PROFIT_LOCK` | number | `0` | Stop for the day once this much is banked (0 = off, the default). |
| `HA_SCALP_ENTRY_END` | time | — | No new entries after this time (IST). |
| `HA_SCALP_ENTRY_START` | time | — | No entries before this (IST). |
| `HA_SCALP_FORCED_EXIT` | time | `15:15` | Hard square-off time (IST). A trade no candle rule has closed is closed here. |
| `HA_SCALP_HISTORY_LAG_MS` | number | `5000` | How long after a bar closes before the Fyers history endpoint is asked for it. Too short and the bar is not published yet, which delays every decision by a whole candle. |
| `HA_SCALP_LIVE_DRY_RUN` | toggle | `false` | Keep it simulated even when live is on. |
| `HA_SCALP_LIVE_ENABLED` | toggle | `false` | Enable live orders via Zerodha. NEVER traded — paper-validate first. |
| `HA_SCALP_LOT_MULTIPLIER` | number | `0` | Lots per trade. 0 = use the global LOT_MULTIPLIER, which is the default (1 lot). |
| `HA_SCALP_MA_TYPE` | select | `sma` | Simple or exponential. The rules were read off a plain 50 MA. |
| `HA_SCALP_MAX_DAILY_LOSS` | number | `3000` | Stop trading after this much loss (0 = off). |
| `HA_SCALP_MAX_DAILY_LOSSES` | number | `2` | Day ends after this many stop-outs (0 = off). |
| `HA_SCALP_MAX_DAILY_TRADES` | number | `3` | Max entries per day. |
| `HA_SCALP_MAX_WEEKLY_LOSS` | number | `0` | Stop for the week after this much loss (0 = off). |
| `HA_SCALP_PAPER_ENABLED` | toggle | `true` | Allow new HA Scalp paper sessions. |
| `HA_SCALP_POLL_MS` | number | `2000` | How often the option premium is refreshed while a trade is open. Spot comes from the shared tick socket, so nothing else is polled. |
| `HA_SCALP_SESSION_START` | time | — | Where the session's bars start being counted (IST). |
| `HA_SCALP_WARMUP_DAYS` | number | `15` | How far back to fetch on start so the MA and the HA chain are established. At 25 bars a session, 15 calendar days is comfortably more than the ~51 bars needed, even across holidays. |

## Instrument & Backtest

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `BACKTEST_CAPITAL` | number | `100000` | Backtest Capital (₹) |
| `BACKTEST_DELTA` | number | `0.55` | Option delta for premium simulation. |
| `BACKTEST_OPTION_SIM` | toggle | `true` | Simulate option P&L in the legacy backtest. |
| `BACKTEST_SLIPPAGE_PTS` | number | `1.5` | Simulated slippage per side, in points. |
| `BACKTEST_THETA_DAY` | number | `8` ⚠️ also `10`×4 | Daily theta decay in rupees. |
| `BB_RSI_LIVE_ENABLED` | toggle | `false` | Second gate for BB_RSI Live. Off = BB_RSI stays simulated even with the global switch off. |
| `CHART_ENABLED` | toggle | `true` | Show the candlestick chart on status pages. |
| `EXPIRY_AUTO_ROLL_ENABLED` | toggle | `true` | When the expiry above is blank or expired, replace it with the next one automatically. |
| `EXPIRY_HEALTHCHECK_ENABLED` | toggle | `true` | Check before the open that the expiry names a contract the broker quotes. |
| `EXPIRY_HEALTHCHECK_MINS` | number | — | How often to re-check the expiry (08:00–15:30 IST). After the close it always runs at 15:40, retrying at 16:15 / 16:30 / 16:45, so a just-expired date rolls the same day. |
| `FYERS_INV_AMOUNT` | number | `100000` | Paper money pool for Fyers strategies (₹). |
| `GAP_THRESHOLD_PTS` | number | `50` | Skip the first candle on a big overnight gap. |
| `HARD_SL_DELTA` | number | `0.5` | Delta used to convert the spot stop to a premium trigger. |
| `HARD_SL_ENABLED` | toggle | `false` | Place a stop-loss order at the exchange on entry. |
| `HARNESS_EXCHANGE_SL_ENABLED` | toggle | `false` | Leave a stop-loss order at the exchange for harness-run strategies (Trend PB, EMA9+VWAP, TDS). Off = the stop only lives in this process and dies with it. |
| `HARNESS_SL_PCT` | number | `0.5` | How far below the entry premium that stop sits. 0.5 = trigger at half the premium paid. |
| `INSTRUMENT` | select | `(not NIFTY_FUTURES)` ⚠️ also `NIFTY_OPTIONS`×1 | Options (CE/PE) or Futures. |
| `LIVE_EXIT_WAIT_MS` | number | — | How long to wait on a live exit before alerting (ms). |
| `LIVE_HARNESS_DRY_RUN` | toggle | `true` | Global switch: log live orders but place none. |
| `LOT_MULTIPLIER` | number | `1` | Number of lots per trade. |
| `LTP_STALE_FALLBACK_SEC` | number | `5` | Use candle close if the option price is older than this (sec). |
| `LTP_STALE_THRESHOLD_SEC` | number | `15` | Warn if the option price hasn't updated for this long (sec). |
| `MAX_BID_ASK_SPREAD_PTS` | number | `2` | Reject entries when the spread is wider than this. |
| `NIFTY_LOT_SIZE` | number | — | Quantity per lot. |
| `NIFTY_SPOT_FALLBACK` | number | `0` ⚠️ also `24000`×1 | Fallback NIFTY price when no live quote. |
| `OPTION_CHAIN_RECORD_INTERVAL_SEC` | number | `5` | How often to record the option chain (sec). |
| `OPTION_CHAIN_RECORD_OI` | toggle | `true` | Also capture each strike's Open Interest from the same quotes (no extra API calls). Feeds the OI Monitor and chain_oi.jsonl. Fyers has no historical-OI API, so turning this off means that day's OI is gone for good. |
| `OPTION_CHAIN_RECORD_STRIKES` | number | `5` | Strikes each side of ATM to record. |
| `OPTION_CHAIN_RECORDER_ENABLED` | toggle | `true` | Record the option chain for replay. |
| `OPTION_EXPIRY_OVERRIDE` | date | `` | Option expiry for all strategies. Filled in automatically once the stored one expires; a future date you set is left alone. |
| `OPTION_EXPIRY_TYPE` | select | `weekly` | Weekly or monthly expiry. |
| `OPTION_SOCKET_FEED_ENABLED` | toggle | `true` | Get held option prices from the live feed instead of repeated REST polls. Off = every strategy polls on its own timer. |
| `PA_LIVE_ENABLED` | toggle | `false` | Second gate for PA Live. Off = PA stays simulated even with the global switch off. |
| `PAPER_CAPITAL_EST_PREMIUM` | number | `200` | EMA_RSI_ST / EMA9+VWAP / BB_RSI / PA decide before their option quote arrives — this premium is assumed for the check, then corrected to the real one a second later. |
| `PAPER_CAPITAL_GATE_ENABLED` | toggle | `true` | Treat the investment amounts as real money: block qty × premium on entry, release it with the P&L on exit, so profits grow the pool and losses shrink it. Running out never stops a trade — the Real-Time dashboard raises an alert instead. Off = display only. |
| `SPOT_FEED_ALWAYS_ON` | toggle | `true` | Record the spot feed all day, even with no strategy running. |
| `STRIKE_OFFSET_CE` | number | falls back to `STRIKE_OFFSET` | CE strike vs ATM (-50=ITM, 0=ATM, +50=OTM). |
| `STRIKE_OFFSET_PE` | number | falls back to `STRIKE_OFFSET` | PE strike vs ATM (+50=ITM, 0=ATM, -50=OTM). |
| `TICK_RECORDER_ENABLED` | toggle | `true` | Record ticks so sessions can be replayed. |
| `TICK_RECORDER_RETAIN_DAYS` | number | `30` | Delete tick recordings older than this. |
| `TIME_STOP_CANDLES` | number | `4` | Default time-stop window, in candles. |
| `TIME_STOP_FLAT_PTS` | number | `20` | Flat-P&L band that triggers the time-stop. |
| `TRADE_RESOLUTION` | select | `5` | Candle timeframe in minutes. One global setting — every strategy uses it. |
| `TRADE_START_TIME` | time | `09:15` | Market open time (IST). |
| `TRADE_STOP_TIME` | time | `15:30` | Auto-stop and square-off time (IST). |
| `VIX_FAIL_MODE` | select | `closed` | What to do when VIX data is missing. |
| `ZERODHA_INV_AMOUNT` | number | `100000` | Paper money pool for Zerodha strategies (₹). |

## ORB STRATEGY (Opening Range Breakout) — Fyers

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ORB_BODY_ATR_MULT` | number | `0` | Breakout candle must be at least this decisive. |
| `ORB_BODY_OR_CAP` | number | `0` | Ceiling on the body filter as a share of today's opening range. ATR(5m) comes from previous days, so after a violent day it can demand a body bigger than today's whole range (2026-08-06: 22.2pt needed vs a 38.95pt range). 0.25 = never ask for more than a quarter of the range. Can only let MORE breakouts through. |
| `ORB_BREAKEVEN_PTS` | number | `20` | Move stop to entry after this many points profit (0 = off). |
| `ORB_BREAKOUT_RESCAN` | toggle | `true` | OFF = the first close beyond the range is final, even if it fails the body filter (old behaviour). |
| `ORB_BT_SEED_PREMIUM` | number | `240` | Assumed entry premium for the backtest (₹). |
| `ORB_BT_SLIPPAGE_PTS` | number | `1.5` | Backtest cost per side, in points. |
| `ORB_BUFFER_ATR_MULT` | number | — | Second half of the buffer; the larger of this and the ×OR value wins. |
| `ORB_BUFFER_MIN_PTS` | number | `0` | Absolute floor on the breakout buffer. Set all three buffer fields to 0 for a plain close past the line. |
| `ORB_BUFFER_OR_MULT` | number | — | How far past the range edge a close must be. Lowering it takes more trades but measurably worse ones (PF 0.93 → 0.64 at 0.10 on the Mar–Apr 2026 sample) — leave it alone. |
| `ORB_CANDLE_TRAIL_CANDLES` | number | `2` | How many candles the trailing stop must clear. 1 = the just-closed candle's low/high (tightest). 2 = that candle and the one before it, matching the 'lookback' initial stop. |
| `ORB_CONFIRM_MODE` | select | `close` | extend = next candle needs a higher high AND higher close beyond the edge. close = it only has to close beyond the breakout candle's close. |
| `ORB_DEBUG_TRACE` | toggle | `false` | Log why entries did or didn't fire (verbose). |
| `ORB_ENTRY_END` | time | `11:30` | No new entries after this time (IST). |
| `ORB_ENTRY_START` | time | `` | No breakout candle is even looked at before this (blank/09:30 = start hunting the moment the range freezes). Skips the 09:35-type entries — but MEASURE IT FIRST: on the Jul–Aug 2026 export the early trades lost less than the late ones (−₹2,372 over 9 before 09:50 vs −₹4,213 over 8 after) and a delay deletes the sample's two best trades. |
| `ORB_EXPIRY_DAY_ONLY` | toggle | `false` | Only trade on weekly expiry day. |
| `ORB_FORCED_EXIT` | time | `15:15` | Hard end-of-day exit time (IST). |
| `ORB_GAP_OR_MULT` | number | `0` | Skip the day on an oversized overnight gap. |
| `ORB_LIVE_ENABLED` | toggle | `false` | Enable live ORB orders via Fyers. |
| `ORB_LOSS_STREAK_SKIP` | number | `4` | Skip a day after this many losing days (0 = off). |
| `ORB_MAX_DAILY_LOSS` | number | `3000` | Stop taking NEW entries once the day is down this much. It cannot close a trade that is already open, and with Max Trades/Day = 1 the budget is spent anyway — raise Max Trades/Day for it to bite. |
| `ORB_MAX_DAILY_TRADES` | number | `1` | Max entries per day. |
| `ORB_MAX_SPREAD_PTS` | number | falls back to `MAX_BID_ASK_SPREAD_PTS` | Skip entry if the bid-ask spread is wider than this. |
| `ORB_MAX_TRADE_LOSS` | number | `0` | Ships OFF so the structural stop is the real stop. When set it clamps the placed SL, which is tighter than the strategy's own level on most trades — use Max Daily Loss for risk control instead. |
| `ORB_MAX_WEEKLY_LOSS` | number | `9000` | Stop for the week after this much loss (0 = off). |
| `ORB_OR_ATR_MAX` | number | `0` | Skip the day if the opening range is too wide. |
| `ORB_OR_MAX_PTS` | number | `0` | Skip the day when the opening range is wider than this many points. Measure with scripts/orbSweep.js before enabling. |
| `ORB_PREMIUM_GATE_ENABLED` | toggle | `false` | Skip entries when the option price is out of range. |
| `ORB_PREMIUM_MAX` | number | `400` | Skip entry if the option price is above this (₹). |
| `ORB_PREMIUM_MIN` | number | `120` | Skip entry if the option price is below this (₹). |
| `ORB_PREMIUM_STOP_PCT` | number | `35` | Exit if the option premium drops this % (0 = off). |
| `ORB_RANGE_END` | time | `09:30` | Opening-range end time (IST). |
| `ORB_RANGE_START` | time | `09:15` | Opening-range start time (IST). |
| `ORB_REENTRY_AFTER_SL` | number | `0` | Extra attempts allowed after the breakout is STOPPED OUT, on top of Max Trades/Day. The hunt re-arms past the stop candle, so only a genuinely fresh close beyond the same range edge can re-enter (2026-08-03 would re-enter 10:45, 2026-07-29 at 10:05). An EMA-trail or EOD exit never re-arms — that means the move ended, not that the breakout was wrong. UNPROVEN: measure with scripts/orbSweep.js before leaving it on. |
| `ORB_RETEST_MAX_WAIT` | number | `6` | Candles to wait for a retest or resume (0 = off). |
| `ORB_RISK_THROTTLE_ENABLED` | toggle | `true` | Pause after a bad week or a losing streak. |
| `ORB_RSI_CE_MIN` | number | `51` | CE entries need RSI at or above this. |
| `ORB_RSI_ENABLED` | toggle | `true` | CE needs RSI at or above the CE floor, PE at or below the PE ceiling, read on the candle being bought. Off = no RSI check. |
| `ORB_RSI_PE_MAX` | number | `49` | PE entries need RSI at or below this. |
| `ORB_RSI_PERIOD` | number | `14` | RSI lookback on 5-min closes. |
| `ORB_SL_ATR_MULT` | number | `0` | Initial stop width as a multiple of ATR. |
| `ORB_SL_LOOKBACK_CANDLES` | number | `2` | Only read when the anchor is 'lookback'. 2 = the entry candle and the one before it — the stop clears the recent swing instead of a single bar. Ignored by the other two anchors. |
| `ORB_SL_SOURCE` | select | `breakout` | Which candle's low/high the initial stop sits under: the entry candle, the first candle that closed past the range edge, or lookback = the extreme of the last N candles ending at the entry candle (N below). |
| `ORB_ST_ENABLED` | toggle | `true` | CE only when SuperTrend is bullish, PE only when bearish, read on the candle being bought. Off = no SuperTrend check. |
| `ORB_ST_MULT` | number | `3` | SuperTrend ATR multiplier. |
| `ORB_ST_PERIOD` | number | `10` | SuperTrend ATR period. |
| `ORB_TRAIL_CONFIRM_CLOSES` | number | `1` | How many closes in a row on the wrong side of the EMA before exiting. 1 = today's rule. 2 rides out one noise candle but gives back a bar when the move is really over. |
| `ORB_TRAIL_EMA` | number | `20` | Trail exit: leave when price closes back across this EMA. |
| `ORB_VIX_ENABLED` | toggle | `false` | Block entries when VIX is high. |
| `ORB_VIX_MAX_ENTRY` | number | `22` | Block entries above this VIX. |
| `ORB_VIX_STRONG_ONLY` | number | falls back to `VIX_STRONG_ONLY` | Above this VIX, allow only strong signals. |
| `ORB_VWAP_FILTER_ENABLED` | toggle | `false` | Measured worthless here: it removed 0 of 36 breakouts on the Mar–Apr 2026 sample. Off costs nothing and skips the VWAP maths. |

## RSI_PIVOT_ST STRATEGY (RSI + Standard Pivot R1/S1 + SuperTrend) — Zerodha

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `RSI_PIVOT_ST_BT_SEED_PREMIUM` | number | `180` | Starting option price the backtest assumes, since there is no historical option chain. The 25% stop is measured against this simulated premium, so it is the weakest number in any backtest result. |
| `RSI_PIVOT_ST_BT_SLIPPAGE_PTS` | number | `2` | Backtest cost per side, in points. Without this, option-buying backtests always flatter. |
| `RSI_PIVOT_ST_ENTRY_END` | time | — | No new entries after this time (IST) — too late in the day for a fresh trade to work out. |
| `RSI_PIVOT_ST_ENTRY_START` | time | — | No entries before this (IST). The first candles of the day are noisy and often break a pivot for no reason. |
| `RSI_PIVOT_ST_EXIT_TIME` | time | — | Everything still open is closed at this time (IST). Nothing is carried overnight. |
| `RSI_PIVOT_ST_LIVE_ENABLED` | toggle | `false` | Enable live orders via Zerodha. NEVER traded — paper-validate first. |
| `RSI_PIVOT_ST_LOT_MULTIPLIER` | number | `0` | Lots per trade. 0 = use the global LOT_MULTIPLIER, which is the default. |
| `RSI_PIVOT_ST_MAX_WEEKLY_LOSS` | number | `0` | Stop trading for the rest of the week after this much loss across Mon–today (0 = off). Read from the day files, so it survives a restart. |
| `RSI_PIVOT_ST_PAPER_ENABLED` | toggle | `true` | Allow new RSI Pivot ST paper sessions. |
| `RSI_PIVOT_ST_PIVOT_BUFFER_PTS` | number | `0` | How far past R1 (or S1) the candle must close before it counts as a break. 0 = a close just beyond the level is enough. Raise it to ignore candles that only tickle the line. |
| `RSI_PIVOT_ST_PREMIUM_SL_SIDES` | select | `BOTH` | Which side carries the premium stop. WARNING: PE has no other stop — it never uses the SuperTrend — so choosing "CE only" or "Neither" leaves every PE trade with NO stop at all, and the 15:15 square-off becomes its only exit. The same is true for CE if you also switch the SuperTrend stop off above. The engine still takes those trades but warns loudly in the log. |
| `RSI_PIVOT_ST_SESSION_START` | time | — | When the strategy starts watching candles for the day (IST). |
| `RSI_PIVOT_ST_ST_SIDES` | select | `` | Which side uses the SuperTrend line as its stop and trail, on top of the premium stop. CE is the original rule. On PE the line is mirrored: it sits ABOVE price and a flip to bullish is the exit. A side that uses it also gains the "SuperTrend must be on the right side of price" entry check, so it takes FEWER trades; a side without it relies on the premium stop alone. |
| `RSI_PIVOT_ST_STRIKE_MODE` | select | `OTM` | Which strike to buy. ATM = nearest to spot. OTM = 1% of spot away from the money (cheaper, needs a bigger move). ITM = 1% into the money (costlier, moves more with spot). |

## SIMPLE_9:30 STRATEGY (option-premium breakout) — Zerodha

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `SIMPLE930_BT_SLIPPAGE_PTS` | number | — | Backtest cost per side, in points. Without this, option-buying backtests always flatter. |
| `SIMPLE930_ENTRY_END` | time | — | If neither watchlist leg has cleared the trigger by this time (IST) there is no trade today — nothing re-arms later in the session. |
| `SIMPLE930_ENTRY_START` | time | — | Entries are allowed from this moment (IST). It opens with the watchlist rather than at 09:30 because the rule is take it as soon as it is above the trigger, not wait for a round number. |
| `SIMPLE930_FORCED_EXIT` | time | — | Hard square-off time (IST) for a trade that expanded out of the box and that the trail never took out. |
| `SIMPLE930_LIVE_ENABLED` | toggle | `false` | Enable live orders via Zerodha. NEVER traded, paper or live — paper-validate first, then diff a recorded session in /replay. |
| `SIMPLE930_LOT_MULTIPLIER` | number | `0` | Lots per trade. 0 = use the global LOT_MULTIPLIER, which is the default. |
| `SIMPLE930_LTP_STALE_MS` | number | `15000` | Refuse an entry when the last premium is older than this. A stalled quote feed would otherwise buy a break that happened minutes ago, at a price that no longer exists. |
| `SIMPLE930_MAX_DAILY_LOSS` | number | `0` | Stop trading after this much loss (0 = off). |
| `SIMPLE930_MAX_DAILY_TRADES` | number | `1` | The rule is one trade a day — the entry window shuts at 09:35 and nothing re-arms after it, so raising this only bites if the window is widened too. |
| `SIMPLE930_PAPER_ENABLED` | toggle | `true` | Allow new SIMPLE_9:30 paper sessions. |
| `SIMPLE930_POLL_MS` | number | `1000` | How often the two watchlist premiums are fetched. This is the granularity the trigger AND every exit are checked at — the shared tick socket carries the INDEX, and every decision this strategy makes is read off an option premium. |
| `SIMPLE930_SELECTION_TIME` | time | — | The single instant (IST) the ITM ladder is quoted and the day's two candidates — one CE, one PE — are frozen. It never re-picks: a watchlist that drifts with spot could not be re-derived by Replay. |
| `SIMPLE930_SIDEWAYS_CHECK` | time | — | At this time (IST) a trade still boxed inside the band below is closed at market, whatever the P&L — it spent the whole move going nowhere. A trade that already left the box is left alone and the trail owns it from there. |
